generation.scope: On the nine-dimensional half-period frame chart the central quadratic quotient is independent of all three weights. For each frame its standard quotient Hilbert series and vanishing two-sided socles are equivalent to regularity with a regular central polarization at every admissible weight; one good weight suffices. An explicit rational frame and every lift of its good residue in characteristic 53 satisfy this criterion for every nonzero weight, with no valuation restriction on the weights.

open_mathematics: Determine the common central quotient for general frames, including special frame positions. Use the constant relation subspaces from the two rulings and the four rank-one forms; general closed-point AS membership and unrestricted component coverage remain open.
